text: Last One To Die's a Sissy!
With a hangover-defying cry, the Venators throw themselves into the melee, before heroically liberating the enemy baggage.
Death or Riches!
The company halts to fire a crossbow volley at the enemy. If there isn't anybody alive to call it unfair, it ain't.
Daemons on Horseback
The combination of the Desert Dogs' surprise attacks and chilling warcries is enough to unnerve most enemies.
Leader: Richter Kreugar

The Cursed Company is bound to Kreugar's will, not by an active necromantic spell but by a much more intricate malediction and a parody of his former mercenary career. They will march with him until he himself is dust.
Join Us in Damnation...
As Kreugar and his undead companions cut down their opponents, the victim's flesh decays in an instant and is bound by the Curse, rising again and joining the silent company.
Join Us in Damnation... (Slaughter)
The terrorized foe is silently cut down while the many slain rise up and turn against their former comrades. The Cursed Company will leave the battlefield larger than it was.
Banner of Kalad

The company's standard bearer carries the skin of Mengil's own brother, that Manhide had flayed alive by Naggaroth's law. Such was the power of the act and of the slain sorcerer, that the banner is still imbued of dark magic.
Flayers
Mengil's Manflayers rarely pursue those who flee, or at least not immediately. They most often start flaying and consuming their victims on the spot, with a revolting glee.
Flayers (Disgust)

While already not a sight for anyone before breakfast with their cloaks of skin, the Manflayers are of course downright disturbing even to their 'allies' when they start flaying and eating their fresh victims.
Dragon Tamer
Even amongst Caledorians, Asarnil has a special connection to dragons of any kind. Atop Deathfang, he might achieve air superiority with a single glare or dragon breath.
Blessing of Enxilada
The Raiders are from a special and rare spawning. When their task is verging on the impossible, a torpor seems to fall on the attacking enemies.
Press On!
Crush the enemies as they falter! Press on, for your fathers, for your families, for victory and the baggage train!
Unlimber Artillery

It ain't right, that's what. Guns are suppose to stay put, not gallop off whenever you get anywhere near them. And firing while they're doing it is outrageous! I'm gonna file a complaint, that's what. It ain't right.

That ain't good. Up we go, lads.
Up and Under

'Tis simple, my lord. I have a cunning plan! First we buzz in low, hedge-hopping for good measure. Then it's up and under and in from the sun. Keeping an eye out for Archie, of course. Corkscrew and pull out, trying not to prang. Then the wingies will strafe. My number two is in and out and we're away!\\n\\n"Can you say that again, more slowly?"
